profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, and listed on the SEC EDGAR registry under CIK 0001773383 with the ticker DT. Its website describes it as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, and says it aims to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes. The company describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader and says its platform turns data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The site states that the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management, a view attributed on the site to Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC. The site also quotes a customer saying that Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The record held on the company includes no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It lists Massachusetts as a jurisdiction with 191 entries under law exposure.
